The '''''Scythe''''' was a [[Phi-class shuttle|''Phi''-class shuttle]] used by as a [[command ship]] by the [[Inquisitorius]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] during the [[Imperial Era]]. 

==Description==
[[File:Scythe-OWKp3.png|thumb|200px|left|Dorsal view of the ''Scythe'']]
The ''Scythe'' was a [[Phi-class shuttle|''Phi''-class shuttle]] of the [[Inquisitorius]], the [[Galactic Empire]]'s group of [[Jedi hunter]]s.<ref name="Dawn of Rebellion TVG" /> The sleek [[starship]] was named for the [[Sith]] that the Inquisitors served and boasted harsh angles and an intimidating frame.<ref name="Scythe DB">{{Databank|scythe|Scythe}}</ref> It had a [[hyperdrive]] and was armed with a pair of <ref name="Part I" /> [[GA-60s double laser cannon]]s.<ref name="GoH" />

==Role==
Under the [[Dark Lord of the Sith]]s [[Darth Sidious]] and [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]], the Inquisitors [[Pilot|flew]] the ''Scythe'' as their [[command ship]].<ref name="Dawn of Rebellion TVG" /> The vessel not only ferried Inquisitors back to their [[Fortress Inquisitorius|fortress]] on the [[moon]] [[Nur]] but also struck fear into anyone who dared to shelter [[Jedi]] fugitives.<ref name="Scythe DB" />

==History==
===Rise of the Inquisitors===
In [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Bar'leth">''[[Inquisitor: Rise of the Red Blade]]'' establishes that the [[mission to Bar'leth]] took place after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Revenge of the Sith'']] and before the events of [[Darth Vader (2017) 7|''Darth Vader'' (2017) 7]], both of which ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates to [[19 BBY]]. Therefore the events on [[Bar'leth]] must take place that year.</ref> the ''Scythe'' was used to transport [[Grand Inquisitor|the Grand Inquisitor]] and former [[Jedi Knight]] [[Thirteenth Sister|Iskat Akaris]] to [[Bar'leth]] to retrieve Jedi and Sith artifacts from the shopkeeper [[Gamodar]]. The [[Mission to Bar'leth|mission]] was a success and the two returned in the vessel to [[Coruscant]].<ref name="Inquisitor">''[[Inquisitor: Rise of the Red Blade]]''</ref>

Sometime later, Akaris used the [[shuttle]] to visit her [[homeworld]] of [[Pkori]]. She and a contingent of [[Purge Trooper]]s later used the ship as transportation to [[Firrhana]] during a [[Mission to Firrhana|hunt for Jedi]].<ref name="Inquisitor" />

The Grand Inquisitor piloted the ''Scythe'' in a space battle with the Jedi fugitive [[Tensu Run]].<ref name="Inquisitors 4">[[Inquisitors 4|''Inquisitors'' 4]]</ref>

===Hunt for Kenobi===
In [[9 BBY]]<ref name="Kenobi date">{{KenobiDate|I}}</ref>, the ''Scythe'' [[Search for Nari|traveled]] to [[Tatooine]], carrying the Grand Inquisitor, [[Reva Sevander|Third Sister]], and [[Fifth Brother]], who were hunting for the [[Jedi]] [[Nari]].<ref name="Part I" />

Later, during the Third Sister's [[Hunt for Obi-Wan|hunt]] for [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], the ''Scythe'' ferried her to Nur's Fortress Inquisitorius, where she met with the [[Fourth Sister]] and Fifth Brother to discuss her plan to lead a hunt for Kenobi, approved by Darth Vader.<ref name="Part III">{{Kenobi|Part III}}</ref> Later, the Third Sister, holding the title of Grand Inquisitor, used the transport during the [[attack on Jabiim]].<ref name="Part V">{{Kenobi|Part V}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|the ''Scythe'', which is kind of a meaner version of Krennic's shuttle, crossed with Vader's ''Tyderium [''sic'']'' shuttle.|Doug Chiang|<ref name="Dark Times">{{HomeVideoCite|set=Obi-Wan Kenobi: The Complete Series|featurette=The Dark Times: Villains}}</ref>}}
[[File:ScytheTransportConceptArt.jpg|thumb|right|230px|Concept art of the ''Scythe'' on Tatooine]]
The ''Scythe'' was first pictured in the form of concept art in the sizzle reel for the ''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'' television released on [[Disney+]] in [[November]], [[2021]].<ref name="Sizzle reel">{{WebCite|url=https://www.starwarsnewsnet.com/2021/11/new-obi-wan-kenobi-sizzle-reel-arrives-ahead-of-disney-plus-day.html|text=UPDATE! First 'Obi-Wan Kenobi' Sizzle Reel Arrives for Disney Plus Day|author=Davis, Grant|date=2021-11-12|archivedate=20220526101004}}</ref> It first appeared in the [[Part I|first episode]] of the series, which aired on [[May 26]], 2022.<ref name="Episode 1 Premiere">{{Twitter|obiwankenobi|status/1530019678562549760|''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]''|quote=The time for #ObiWanKenobi has arrived…early. Start streaming the first two episodes on @DisneyPlus TONIGHT at 9PM PT.|archivedate=20220527053945}}</ref> It was first identified in a [[LEGO]] set depicting the transport.<ref name="Lego set">{{LEGOWeb|url=en-us/product/inquisitor-transport-scythe-75336|text=Inquisitor Transport ''Scythe''}}</ref>

The first scene that was shot with [[Moses Ingram]], the actress who played the Third Sister, was her and the other [[Inquisitor]]s stepping off of the ''Scythe'' on Tatooine.<ref name="7 Questions">{{OfficialYouTube|channel=@VanityFair|name=Vanity Fair|video=kWpCRYBq6kM|text=Ewan McGregor, Hayden Christensen & Moses Ingram Answer 7 Star Wars Questions | Vanity Fair}}</ref> When the scene was filmed, a real ramp was used in front of a blue screen. Writer [[Joby Harold]] wanted the scene to have a [[Wikipedia:American frontier|western]] motif with three characters walking down the street as everyone is intimidated.<ref name="Return">''[[Obi-Wan Kenobi: A Jedi's Return]]''</ref> [[Doug Chiang]] described the ship as a "meaner version" of [[ST-149|Krennic's Imperial Shuttle]] and the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]].<ref name="Dark Times" />
